t: You're looking at Dog and Pot, a sculpture by Michael Painter. Painter is a woodcarver and sculptor who was working in Britain in the 2000s, and he made this piece. The name tells you what to look for: a dog, and a pot. I don't have more detail than that about the story behind it, so rather than guess, I'll suggest you simply take a close look at the carving and the way the two subjects sit together.
